messages.text: Hi good morning i have a thor p2 using harlo os and wNT TO GO BACK to thor os were can i find the thor os on this page
I'm H., HeliumDeploy's technical specialist. Let me check where the Thor P2 stock firmware lives right now.
Searched the web · Thor P2 miner stock firmware download revert from Harlo OS
Let me check the Harlo flasher page and where the Hammer stock image lives.
Searched the web · Hammer Miner Thor P2 firmware download official hammerminer.
Found the stock firmware source. Let me confirm the latest release.

Hi, I'm H., HeliumDeploy's technical specialist.

Short answer: the stock Thor OS is not on our site. Our pages only host Harlo OS (the flasher at harlolabs.com), so there is nothing to find on /search. The factory Thor P2 firmware is published by Hammer Miner themselves on GitHub:

1. Go to https://github.com/HammerMiner/P2/releases
2. Latest is 
V1.0.3 20261020
, published 22 Oct 2026 with 3 assets attached
3. Download the asset for the P2 and flash it over USB the same way you flashed Harlo OS (USB data cable, erase, install)

Two things before you do it:

- The flash wipes your settings, so note your pool URL and worker name first.
- Can you tell me why you want to go back? If it is a bug, a hashrate drop or something missing in the UI, I would rather fix that, and in a lot of cases it is already fixed in a newer Harlo build. Which Harlo OS version is the unit on right now (it is in the web UI, System page)?
A hashrate drop and am using firmware  0.2.101  am sick of my miner just doing half of what it should do
Let me check what the current Harlo OS build is before anything else.
Searched the web · Harlo OS latest version release notes 0.2

Thanks, that helps. 0.2.101 on a Thor P2 (2x BM1373, rated 10 TH/s) losing about half usually comes down to one of three things: a preset that came back at a low frequency after the flash, only one of the two chips hashing, or you are comparing the pool number against the local one.

Heads up: I cannot open harlolabs.com from here, so I cannot read out the current version list for you. The flasher page itself always shows the latest build next to your model.

First check, one thing only: open the miner's web UI and send me a screenshot of the dashboard showing hashrate, frequency, core voltage and temperatures (the System or Settings page if frequency is not on the main screen).

While you grab that, tell me one number: what does your pool show as the 24h average for that worker? If the UI says 10 TH/s and the pool says 5, that is a share or rejects problem. If the UI itself says 5, it is clocks or a chip, and that is a different fix.
